data: Apple reported diluted earnings per share of $6.08 in fiscal 2024 (the year ended September 28, 2024), compared with $6.13 in fiscal 2023 (the year ended September 30, 2023). That is a decline of about $0.05, or roughly 0.8%. The fiscal 2024 figure was affected by a one-time income tax charge of about $10.2 billion tied to the European Commission State Aid decision; excluding that charge, diluted EPS would have been about $6.97. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $93.7 billion, down about 3.4% from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023.
